description: Corridor-specific settlement stability score (0–100) for any currency pair. Combines the live global Stability Oracle score with corridor-specific risk adjustments covering 28 currency pairs: regulatory flags (BCB/IOF for BRL, PBoC capital rules for CNH, BCRA controls for ARS, etc.), FX liquidity score based on active trading sessions at current UTC time, cascade penalty from live macro signals, and weekend/off-hours penalty. Returns SETTLE_NOW / DELAY_24H / DELAY_48H recommendation with rationale. Distinct from oracle.stability (which is global) and market.fx (which is spot-rate focused) — this answers "is this specific corridor safe to settle through right now?"
name: stability.corridor
